academic_validation.independent_result: True as written: a binomial has exactly two non-zero terms, therefore it also has at most two terms.
reasoning: Under the standard definition, a binomial has exactly two non-zero terms. Any object with exactly two terms necessarily has no more than two terms, so the statement 'A binomial can have at most two terms' is true in its ordinary logical meaning.
